# German 10: weil, dass, wenn — linking ideas

Give reasons, report what you think, and set conditions. After weil, dass and wenn the verb goes to the end.

## Words

| Word | Plural | Meaning | Pronunciation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| weil | — | because | /vaɪ̯l/ |
| dass | — | that (conjunction) | /das/ |
| wenn | — | if; when(ever) | /vɛn/ |
| aber | — | but | /ˈaːbɐ/ |
| denn | — | because (normal word order) | /dɛn/ |
| oder | — | or | /ˈoːdɐ/ |
| und | — | and | /ʊnt/ |
| glauben | — | to believe; to think | /ˈɡlaʊ̯bn̩/ |
| wissen | — | to know (a fact) | /ˈvɪsn̩/ |
| krank | — | ill; sick | /kʁaŋk/ |
| müde | — | tired | /ˈmyːdə/ |
| das Wetter | — | weather | /ˈvɛtɐ/ |
| der Regen | — | rain | /ˈʁeːɡn̩/ |

## Phrases

- **Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil ich krank bin.**: I am staying at home because I am ill.
- **Ich glaube, dass er heute kommt.**: I think that he is coming today.
- **Wenn es regnet, nehme ich den Bus.**: If it rains, I take the bus.
- **Ich bin müde, denn ich habe schlecht geschlafen.**: I am tired because I slept badly.
- **Weißt du, dass Anna Geburtstag hat?**: Do you know that it is Anna's birthday?
- **Wir gehen spazieren, wenn das Wetter schön ist.**: We go for a walk when the weather is nice.
- **Er lernt Deutsch, weil er in Berlin arbeiten will.**: He is learning German because he wants to work in Berlin.

## Grammar: subordinate clauses

After **weil** (because), **dass** (that) and **wenn** (if, when) the conjugated verb goes to the **end** of its clause:

- *Ich bleibe zu Hause, **weil** ich krank **bin**.*
- *Ich glaube, **dass** er heute **kommt**.*
- With a modal verb, the modal is last: *…, weil er in Berlin arbeiten **will**.*
- A clause first counts as position 1, so the main verb comes right after the comma: *Wenn es regnet, **nehme** ich den Bus.*
- **und, aber, oder, denn** do not change the word order: *…, **denn** ich **habe** schlecht geschlafen.*
- *dass* (conjunction) has two s; *das* is the article or "that" as a pronoun.
